v.n: Unicorn Academy: Secrets Revealed ✨🦄 Chapter 2 | Official…

eps.o: After a mysterious earthquake strikes Unicorn Academy, startling visions of a legendary unicorn send Sophia and her friends searching for answers.
The Sapphires must take care of armaditto pups amidst a heat wave — but the sensitive creatures run wild as new revelations spark fiery frustrations.
As the crew settles in for a night of camping, Rory entertains everyone with spooky stories — and Ava keeps sneaking off to see her new friend Zaya.
The Sapphires travel to Fate Fairy Island to uncover the truth behind the mythical Skywind. As danger grows, can they trust their new Grimorian ally?
